description: This file defines the CanvasScheme enum which provides URL scheme constants, URL creation functionality, and MIME type mappings associated with the 'openclaw-canvas' scheme used in the project.

methods.name: makeURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL with the scheme 'openclaw-canvas' for a given session and optional path.

methods.name: mimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type string corresponding to a file extension.
